$comment: Labels used to assemble content-review material. Shared by the plugin page (ui/src/review.ts via i18n.ts) and the MCP server (server/lib/review_material.rb): the review basis fingerprint is computed over text built from these labels, so both sides must use identical strings. ui/src/review-labels.test.ts fails if i18n.ts drifts from this file.

zh-Hans.reviewFieldTitle: 剧名 / 类型 / 形式
zh-Hans.reviewScopeSelectedImage: 只审选定的这 1 张图。其余没被选用的候选不在本次审核范围内，不要据它们报问题。
zh-Hans.reviewTargetShotImages: 第 {number} 镜的首尾帧提示词
zh-Hans.reviewMediaAttached: 随附 {images} 张图片、{videos} 个视频（视频以按时间顺序抽取的关键帧给出）。请结合画面本身审核，画面里看到的问题同样要报。
zh-Hans.reviewContract: 只输出一个 ```{fence}``` 代码块，JSON 字段：status（pass/warn/block）、summary、issues（数组，每项含 severity（warn/block）、level（must：不改大概率过不了平台审核；advice：风格、口味或可改可不改的优化）、category、location、excerpt、reason、suggestion）。
zh-Hans.panelContextHeader: 【上下文（不是审读对象，只帮你判断）】
zh-Hans.panelRequest: 你是专家席里的{expert}（{role}）。请只从你的职责出发审读下面这份内容：{label}。
zh-Hans.panelChairRequest: 你是专家席的主持人。下面是被审读的内容：{label}，以及各位专家各自给出的意见。请归纳成一份结论。
zh-Hans.panelExpertContract: 只输出一个 ```{fence}``` 代码块，JSON 字段：status（你的立场：pass 没有要改的；warn 有要改的；block 这样不能开拍或不能上线）、summary（一句话）、issues（数组，每项含 severity（warn/block）、level（must/advice）、category、location、excerpt、reason、suggestion）。只写你职责范围内、能在原文指出位置的问题。
zh-Hans.panelChairContract: 只输出一个 ```{fence}``` 代码块，JSON 字段：status（pass/warn/block）、summary、issues（数组，每项含 severity（warn/block）、level（must：不改会出事；advice：可改可不改）、category、location、excerpt、reason、suggestion、raisedBy（提出这条意见的专家名，几位就用「、」连起来））。同一处问题只留一条；专家意见冲突时在 reason 里写明取舍。
zh-Hans.panelSoloInstruction: 你一人分饰下面这整张专家席：先在心里以每位专家的身份各审一遍（各自只管自己的职责），再以主持人的身份把它们归纳成一份结论。只输出主持人的结论。

en.reviewScopeSelectedImage: Only the one selected image is under review. Candidates that were not selected are out of scope; do not report issues from them.
en.reviewMediaAttached: {images} images and {videos} videos are attached (videos as key frames in time order). Review the pictures themselves as well and report anything you see in them.
en.reviewContract: Output exactly one ```{fence}``` code block. JSON fields: status (pass/warn/block), summary, issues (array; each item has severity (warn/block), level (must: likely fails platform review unless fixed; advice: style, taste or an optional improvement), category, location, excerpt, reason, suggestion).
en.panelContextHeader: [Context: not under review, only to inform your judgement]
en.panelRequest: You are the {expert} ({role}) on the expert panel. Review the following content strictly from your seat: {label}.
en.panelChairRequest: You chair the expert panel. Below is the content under review, {label}, followed by each expert's independent opinion. Merge them into one verdict.
en.panelExpertContract: Output exactly one ```{fence}``` code block. JSON fields: status (your stance: pass nothing to change; warn something to change; block cannot be shot or released like this), summary (one sentence), issues (array; each item has severity (warn/block), level (must/advice), category, location, excerpt, reason, suggestion). Only raise issues within your seat that you can point to in the text.
en.panelChairContract: Output exactly one ```{fence}``` code block. JSON fields: status (pass/warn/block), summary, issues (array; each item has severity (warn/block), level (must: trouble unless fixed; advice: optional), category, location, excerpt, reason, suggestion, raisedBy (the expert name(s) who raised it, several joined with commas)). Keep one entry per problem; when experts disagree, state the call you made in reason.
en.panelSoloInstruction: You play this whole expert panel alone: first review once in the voice of each expert (each staying within their seat), then, as the chair, merge those reviews into one verdict. Output only the chair's verdict.
